subject: Yes/No pathway and paperwork sprint for Acme MAP
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Bates <jbates@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Yes/No pathway and paperwork sprint for Acme MAP

Jordan —

Thanks for a productive walkthrough yesterday. Per our MAP, we’re at the last internal gating: exec approval + signature timing so we can hit your requested 7/5 start. To keep this tight I want to propose a short paperwork sprint this week so procurement and legal can close the ECA/SLA items before signatures.

Please confirm these two things by EOD today:
- A single preferred signatory (name + email) for DocuSign (procurement or legal?)
- Any blackout dates for signing next week (we need a 48-hour ESIGN window)

I’ve attached an updated MAP (v3) with the final milestones and a redlines summary for the SLA. Marissa — can you confirm legal’s redline budget and whether the SLA redlines are deal-blocking? Karthik — I want to lock the start date contingent on the final signature window.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Jordan confirms signer + procurement timing by EOD today
2) Redwood sends clean DocuSign envelope tomorrow AM
3) Acme signs within 48 hours -> Redwood countersigns same day
4) Day-1 kickoff materials delivered to Acme CS two business days before start

If we get agreement on the signer today I’ll convert the MAP -> DocuSign and route to legal for countersignature.

Attachments: Acme_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx (tracked changes), SLA_redlines_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

From: Jordan Bates <jbates@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Chen <linda.chen@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Yes/No pathway and paperwork sprint for Acme MAP

Thanks, Stephanie — quick answers below.

1) Signatory: Linda Chen (CRO) will be the primary signer. Email: linda.chen@acme.com. Procurement will coordinate internal approvals — they will be the ones that trigger the DocuSign flow.
2) Blackouts: We have a calendar freeze on 6/18–6/20 for year-end planning, otherwise we are free.

We can aim for signing on 6/23–6/24 which gives our procurement team time to finish a short internal review. If you need an earlier window we can escalate, but 6/23 conservatively works for us.

I reviewed the MAP v3 and the milestones look good. One ask from Product: we want the trial data retention clause clarified to 90 days post-pilot; that was a small redline in the SLA redlines doc.

On the plan you suggested: we’re comfortable with a 48-hour ESIGN window. Procurement will upload countersigned docs to our S3 bucket once signed.

Jordan Bates
VP, Product — Acme Retail
jbates@acme.com | 612-555-0199

To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Yes/No pathway and paperwork sprint for Acme MAP

Stephanie / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick legal check: I reviewed SLA_redlines_v2.pdf and marked three items that need explicit exec signoff:
- Availability SLA: proposed exclusion window for scheduled infra maintenance (we need to agree on notify window)
- Liability cap: suggested carve-out tied to data processing exceptions — legal to propose alternate language
- Trial data retention: can confirm 90 days (Product request) if we add an audit log clause and a deletion certification on Day+30 after pilot end.

None of these are fatal, but they do require an explicit approval line in the final cover sheet. If Acme confirms Linda as signer and procurement confirms 6/23 as the signing window, we can push redlines into an appendix and proceed with DocuSign routing.

Marissa will create a one-page cover letter with the approval ledger and send to Karthik for final exec signoff routing. Karthik — can you confirm you’ll approve the cover letter (I’ll tag the liability language to you)?

Attachments: SLA_redlines_v2.pdf (annotated)

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Bates <jbates@acme.com>, Linda Chen <linda.chen@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Yes/No pathway and paperwork sprint for Acme MAP

Team / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear timeline. I reviewed Marissa’s summary and the annotated redlines. I’m comfortable authorizing the cover letter with the following checks:
- We accept the trial data retention to 90 days conditional on the audit log + deletion certification language Marissa mentioned
- Liability language: accept Marissa’s alternate wording (legal will include the carve-out appendix)
- Availability SLA: Redwood will commit to a 72-hour scheduled maintenance notify window and a remedy credit if missed (non-fatal)

If Acme confirms Linda as signer and procurement confirms the 6/23 signing window, I authorize converting the MAP to a DocuSign envelope and moving to countersignature. Please include a one-line exec approval block in the cover letter with my name and title so Acme has a clear go/no-go record.

Start date: contingent on signatures, we will aim for a 7/5 pilot start. If signing slips past 6/25 we’ll need to move the start to 7/12 to allow CS ramp. Please call out the contingency in the cover sheet.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0222

Attachments: CoverLetter_Acme_approval_v1.docx (to be produced by Marissa), DocuSign_template_redwood_acme_2027.envelope (to be generated)
